facts.fact: Proclamation No. 1370/2025 (Article 4) makes the Immigration and Citizenship Service the registration organ, with structures from federal to the lowest administrative level, keeping registration data in a national database; Article 13(3) refers to the registration technology as developed by the Service.
facts.system: civil registration system (register of civil status)

facts.fact: Proclamation No. 1370/2025, in force on publication on 18 March 2025, provides in law for civil registration done through technology beside the bound book: data to be transferred immediately to the Service's server (Art. 12(3)), entry in an application system (Art. 19(2)), signature through the system (Art. 23(4)) and immediate sending to the Service (Art. 46(2)); it repeals Proclamation No. 760/2012 and does not say that any office registers this way.
facts.system: civil registration system (register of civil status)

systems.platform: bound book, separate sheet of paper, or an appropriate technology (Art. 11)
systems.tiers: registration offices at the lowest administrative level of a Region; also health facilities (births and deaths), first-instance and sharia courts (divorce), Ethiopian missions, ships, the Refugees and Returnees Service and the Ministry of Defence

systems.country_label: application system developed for a technology-based registration system; the Service server; national database
systems.tiers: as provided in law: to be made accessible to all Regions, civil registration offices, missions, the shipping enterprise, the Ministry of Defence and the Refugees and Returnees Service; no deployment stated

systems.system: notification of birth and of death
systems.owner: health facilities; the health structure or professional in the lowest administrative unit
systems.tiers: health facilities hand the paper to the declarant; for events outside a facility the health structure notifies the civil registration office of the place of occurrence

systems.platform: registration form entered on the Service's digital application system; national data server
systems.tiers: as provided in law; no deployment stated
